questions.q: Why couldn't the author get into Lazar's Cave?
o: He didn't check the opening hours in advance: on weekdays organized groups of 20 or more are required
There were no tickets at the box office
questions.e: In the video: "moraćemo to da ostavimo za neki drugi put, zato što se nismo baš dobro raspitali što se tiče radnog vremena... tokom nedelje morate imati organizovanu turu od 20 ili više ljudi" — we'll have to leave that for another time, because we didn't inquire properly about the opening hours... during the week you must have an organized tour of 20 or more people.

questions.q: What is Lazar's Canyon famous for?
questions.e: In the video: "on je najduži kanjon u Srbiji." — it is the longest canyon in Serbia.

questions.q: What did the author exchange for Smile card points?
o: A toy for Nađa — the Lili sheep pillow
questions.e: In the video: "skupio tačno bodova za ovu igračku za Nađu... ja sam tvoj novi prijatelj, ovčica Lili" — I collected exactly enough points for this toy for Nađa... I'm your new friend, Lili the little sheep.

questions.q: Which cave did they go to instead of Lazar's?
o: The Resava Cave — a route of about 800 meters with a concert hall
questions.e: In the video: "Tako da smo odlučili da dođemo u Resavsku pećinu... Put je oko 800 metara kroz pećinu... koncertna dvorana" — so we decided to come to the Resava Cave... The route is about 800 meters through the cave... a concert hall.

questions.q: Why didn't they have dinner at the "Lisinski raj" restaurant?
questions.e: In the video: "Restoran Lisinski raj ostavljamo iza nas, jer ne primaju kartice" — we leave the Lisinski raj restaurant behind us, because they don't accept cards.

questions.q: Why were there so many people at the Krupaja spring?
o: A film was being shot there
It was a Sunday and there is a restaurant nearby with a natural pool
questions.e: In the video: "Danas je nedelja... restoran koji ima neki prirodni bazen u koji dotiče voda sa vrela" — today is Sunday... a restaurant that has a sort of natural pool into which water from the spring flows.

questions.q: What are the rules at Manasija Monastery?
o: No photography and no entering in shorts, a tank top or slippers
An entrance fee must be paid
questions.e: In the video: "U manastiru nije dozvoljeno slikanje... nije dozvoljeno ulaziti u kratkim pantalonama, atlet majici, papučama" — photography is not allowed in the monastery... it's not allowed to enter in short pants, a tank top, slippers.

questions.q: What did the author like about the ethno-village?
o: The animals, home-cooked food and a spacious apartment far from the city
questions.e: In the video: "prvo, imate svuda životinje okolo... Hrana ovde je jako dobra... apartman je toliko velik... van grada" — first, there are animals all around... The food here is very good... the apartment is so big... outside the city.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Radno vreme je ovde, a *ulaznica* je 200 dinara.
questions.e: Ulaznica — an admission ticket.

questions.q: Služi se, naravno, *pastrmka*.
questions.e: Pastrmka — trout.

questions.q: Biljne i životinjske vrste koje su *zaštićene*.
questions.e: Zaštititi — to protect; zaštićen — protected.

questions.q: Obavezne su patike, pošto je jako *blatnjavo*.
questions.e: Blato — mud; blatnjavo — muddy.

questions.q: Okolo su *zidine*.
questions.e: Zid — a wall; zidine — fortress walls.

questions.q: Pokrijete bar *ramena*.
questions.e: Rame — a shoulder.

questions.q: Konji, *magarci*, psi.
questions.e: Magarac — a donkey.

questions.q: Imali smo mesta da stavimo prenosivi *krevetac*.
questions.e: Krevetac — a children's crib; krevet — a bed.

questions.q: Evo nas kod Lazarevog kanjona i kod ___ pećine.
questions.e: Kod ("at, near") takes the genitive. Pećina is feminine, so Lazareve pećine.

questions.q: sreda, četvrtak, petak — samo za ___ grupe.
questions.e: Za + accusative, feminine plural: za najavljene grupe — for pre-announced groups.

questions.q: Lazarev kanjon je najduži kanjon u ___.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u Srbiji.

questions.q: Skupljate bodove na Smile ___.
questions.e: Na in answer to "on what?" — locative case: na kartici.

questions.q: Ima da se ide od mesta gde ostavite auto ___ vodopada.
questions.e: Od … do + genitive: "from the place … to the waterfall": do vodopada.

questions.q: Generalno, ovo je prvo etno-selo koje smo ___.
questions.e: A single completed visit calls for the perfective posetili. Posećivali is imperfective (regular visits). Smo is plural.

questions.q: Naše crkve ne ograničavaju ___.
questions.e: Ograničavati whom — accusative case: žene.

questions.q: Ako imate sitnu ___, neće vam naplatiti ništa.
questions.e: Imati whom — accusative case: sitnu decu.
